explanation: The One who has plenty of mercy for the believers and the blasphemers in this world and exclusively for the believers in the hereafter.
meaningAr: الذي وسعت رحمته كل شيء

explanation: The One who has plenty of mercy for the believers.
meaningAr: المنعم على عباده المؤمنين برحمته الخاصة

explanation: The One with complete dominion, the One whose dominion is clear from imperfection.
meaningAr: الذي له الملك كله يتصرف فيه كيف يشاء

explanation: The One who is pure from any imperfection and clear from children and adversaries.
meaningAr: المنزه عن كل نقص وعيب

explanation: The One who is free from every imperfection.
meaningAr: السالم من كل عيب المسلم عباده من كل ظلم

meaning: The Infuser of Faith / The Guardian
explanation: The One who witnessed for Himself that no one is God but Him and guarantees safety to His servants.
meaningAr: الذي صدق رسله بالآيات وأمن عباده من الظلم

meaning: The Preserver of Safety / The Overseer
explanation: The One who witnesses the saying and deeds of His creatures and protects them.
meaningAr: الرقيب الحافظ الشاهد على كل شيء

explanation: The Defeater who is not defeated and possesses supreme honour.
meaningAr: الغالب الذي لا يقهر ولا يغلب

explanation: The One that nothing happens in His Dominion except that which He willed, and who mends the broken.
meaningAr: الذي يجبر الكسير ويغني الفقير ويقهر الجبابرة

explanation: The One who is clear from the attributes of the creatures and above all arrogance.
meaningAr: المتعالي عن كل نقص المتفرد بالعظمة والكبرياء

explanation: The One who brings everything from non-existence to existence.
meaningAr: الذي أوجد المخلوقات من العدم بقدرته

explanation: The Maker who designs each created entity with perfect individuality.
meaningAr: الذي برأ الخلق وميز بعضهم من بعض

explanation: The One who forms His creatures in different shapes and images.
meaningAr: الذي صور المخلوقات كيف شاء بحكمته

explanation: The One who forgives the sins of His servants time and time again.
meaningAr: الذي يغفر الذنوب مرارا وتكرارا لمن تاب

explanation: The Dominant One who holds absolute power over all things.
meaningAr: الذي قهر كل شيء وخضع له كل موجود

explanation: The One who gives generously without expecting anything in return.
meaningAr: كثير العطاء بلا عوض ولا سؤال

explanation: The One who creates sustenance and provides for all creatures.
meaningAr: المتكفل بأرزاق العباد جميعا

explanation: The One who opens the doors of mercy, victory, and understanding.
meaningAr: الذي يفتح أبواب الرحمة والرزق لعباده

explanation: The One who has vast, infinite knowledge of everything past, present, and future.
meaningAr: المحيط علمه بكل شيء ظاهر وباطن

explanation: The One who constrains sustenance and life according to His wisdom.
meaningAr: الذي يقبض الرزق والأرواح بحكمته وعدله

explanation: The One who expands sustenance, joy, and mercy to whom He wills.
meaningAr: الذي يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء بفضله وكرمه

explanation: The One who lowers the arrogant and the oppressors.
The One who raises the righteous in ranks and honor.
The One who bestows dignity and true power upon His faithful servants.
The One who dishonours tyrants and makes them low.
The One who hears every voice, whispered prayer, and secret thought.
meaningAr: الذي وسع سمعه كل شيء يسمع السر والنجوى

explanation: The One who sees all that exists, visible and invisible.
meaningAr: الذي يرى كل شيء وإن دق وصغر

explanation: The Just Arbiter whose decree cannot be overturned.
meaningAr: الذي يحكم بين عباده بعدله ولا معقب لحكمه

explanation: The One who is absolutely fair and free from any wrongdoing.
The One who knows the finest subtleties and guides affairs with delicate tenderness.
meaningAr: الرفيق بعباده المحسن إليهم في خفاء ولطف

explanation: The One from whose knowledge no hidden reality is concealed.
meaningAr: العالم ببواطن الأمور ودقائقها وخفاياها

explanation: The One who does not rush to punish the sinner and gives chances for repentance.
meaningAr: الذي لا يعجل بالعقوبة ويمهل العصاة للتوبة

explanation: The One whose greatness surpasses human comprehension.
meaningAr: الذي كملت عظمته في ذاته وصفاته وأفعاله

explanation: The One who pardons immense transgressions and shields their consequence.
meaningAr: الذي يستر الذنوب ويغفرها مهما عظمت

explanation: The One who abundantly rewards even the smallest sincere good deed.
meaningAr: الذي يضاعف الثواب ويشكر القليل من العمل

explanation: The One who is above all creation in rank, authority, and status.
meaningAr: الرفيع فوق خلقه بقدرته وقهره وعلو ذاته

explanation: The One who is greater than anything in existence.
meaningAr: الأكبر من كل شيء ذاتا وقدرا وقهرا

explanation: The One who safeguards creation and preserves good deeds.
meaningAr: الحافظ لكل شيء من كل سوء

explanation: The One who delivers bodily food and spiritual nourishment.
meaningAr: المقتدر الموصل لكل مخلوق ما يقوته

explanation: The One who suffices His servants and takes account of every deed.
meaningAr: الكافي عباده المحاسب لهم على أعمالهم

explanation: The One who is attributed with supreme greatness and majesty.
The One who gives without measure and pardons without reproach.
meaningAr: كثير الخير والعطاء الذي لا ينفد

explanation: The One from whom nothing is absent and who watches every heart.
meaningAr: المطلع على كل شيء الحافظ له

explanation: The One who answers the supplicant when they call upon Him.
meaningAr: الذي يجيب دعاء من دعاه ويعطي من سأله

explanation: The One whose mercy, knowledge, and bounty encompass all things.
meaningAr: الذي وسع كل شيء رحمة وعلما وغنى

explanation: The One who places everything in its rightful place with ultimate wisdom.
meaningAr: الذي يضع الأمور مواضعها بحكمته البالغة

explanation: The One who loves His righteous servants and is beloved to their hearts.
meaningAr: المحب لعباده الصالحين المحبوب لهم

explanation: The One with supreme nobility, grandeur, and generosity.
meaningAr: الواسع في المجد والعظمة والإحسان إلى خلقه

explanation: The One who brings the dead back to life on the Day of Resurrection.
The One who is present and witnesses everything that happens.
meaningAr: الحاضر الذي لا يغيب عنه شيء

explanation: The One whose existence and promises are absolute and eternal.
meaningAr: الثابت الوجود الذي لا شك فيه

meaning: The Trustee / The Disposer of Affairs
explanation: The One upon whom all faithful souls rely for every need.
meaningAr: المتولي أمور عباده الكافيهم ما أهمهم

explanation: The One with inexhaustible, limitless power.
meaningAr: الكامل القوة الذي لا يعجزه شيء

explanation: The One whose power is steadfast and never wavers.
meaningAr: شديد القوة الذي لا يلحقه تعب ولا نصب

explanation: The Guardian and Ally of the righteous believers.
meaningAr: الناصر لعباده المؤمنين المتولي أمورهم

explanation: The One who deserves all praise in every circumstance.
meaningAr: المستحق للحمد والثناء في كل حال

explanation: The One who counts and knows the precise number of all things.
The One who initiates creation from nothingness.
The One who recreates and restores creation after its death.
The One who grants life to bodies and hearts.
The One who ordains death at the appointed time.
The One who possesses eternal, perfect life without beginning or end.
meaningAr: الذي له الحياة الكاملة الدائمة التي لا تزول

explanation: The One who sustains all existence and depends on nothing.
meaningAr: القائم بنفسه المقيم لغيره الغني عن كل شيء

explanation: The One who lacks nothing and finds all that He desires.
The One with infinite generosity and sublime nobility.
The One who is unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.
meaningAr: المتفرد بالألوهية والربوبية والأسماء والصفات

explanation: The Sole One who has no partner, equal, or likeness.
meaningAr: المتفرد في ذاته وصفاته لا نظير له

explanation: The Self-Sufficient upon whom all creation depends for every need.
meaningAr: الذي تقصده الخلائق في حوائجها لكماله

explanation: The One who is able to do anything without limitation.
meaningAr: المتصف بالقدرة التامة على كل شيء

explanation: The One whose power enacts decrees flawlessly.
meaningAr: الكامل القدرة الذي لا يمتنع عليه شيء

explanation: The One who brings forward what He wills in time and honor.
meaningAr: الذي يقدم من يشاء بفضله ويؤخر من يشاء بعدله

explanation: The One who delays what He wills according to perfect wisdom.
meaningAr: الذي يؤخر من يشاء بحكمته وعدله

explanation: The One whose existence has no beginning.
meaningAr: الذي ليس قبله شيء، فكل ما سواه حادث مخلوق بعده

explanation: The One whose existence has no end.
meaningAr: الذي ليس بعده شيء، الباقي بعد فناء خلقه

explanation: The One whose existence is evident through His signs and creation.
meaningAr: الذي ليس فوقه شيء، العالي فوق خلقه بقهره وعلوه

explanation: The One who is hidden from sight yet closer than the jugular vein.
meaningAr: الذي ليس دونه شيء، المحتجب عن الأبصار العالم بخفايا الأمور

explanation: The Master who exercises dominion over all things.
The One who is exalted above any creation and flaw.
meaningAr: المتنزه عن كل سوء ونقص ومماثلة للمخلوقات

explanation: The One who is kind, beneficent, and fulfilling of His promises.
meaningAr: المحسن إلى خلقه ببره ولطفه

explanation: The One who continually accepts sincere repentance and turns with forgiveness.
meaningAr: الذي يقبل التوبة من عباده ويعفو عنهم

explanation: The One who justly recompenses unrepentant oppressors.
The One who obliterates sins entirely without leaving a trace.
meaningAr: الذي يمحو السيئات ويتجاوز عن المعاصي

explanation: The One with ultimate tenderness, pity, and gentle care.
The Eternal Owner of all sovereignty and dominions.
meaningAr: الذي يؤتي الملك من يشاء وينزعه ممن يشاء

explanation: The Possessor of absolute Glory, Honour, and Bounties.
meaningAr: المستحق للتعظيم والإكرام وحده

explanation: The One who judges with pure justice and fairness.
The One who gathers humanity together on the Day of Judgment.
meaningAr: الذي يجمع الخلائق ليوم القيامة للحساب

explanation: The One who is free of all needs while all else needs Him.
meaningAr: المستغني عن كل ما سواه المفتقر إليه كل شيء

explanation: The One who satisfies the needs of His creatures and enriches them.
The One who shields from harm and withholds for wise reasons.
The One who allows hardship as a trial or purification.
The One who brings benefit, blessings, and joy to whom He wills.
The Illuminator of the heavens and the earth.
meaningAr: الذي نور السماوات والأرض وهدى أهلها

explanation: The One who guides hearts to faith and righteousness.
meaningAr: الذي يهدي من يشاء إلى الحق والصراط المستقيم

explanation: The One who created the universe without previous model or blueprint.
meaningAr: المبدع للسماوات والأرض على غير مثال سابق

explanation: The One who remains forever when all else perishes.
The One who remains the owner of all after creation fades away.

meaning: The Guide to the Right Path
explanation: The One who directs all affairs with unerring perfection and guidance.
The One who does not hurry to enact judgment and whose patience is limitless.
